instruction: Set a larger mouse pointer for easier viewing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: CURSOR_SIZE=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CURSOR_SIZE" ] && [ "$CURSOR_SIZE" -gt 24 ]; then echo "Large cursor enabled (size: $CURSOR_SIZE)"; else echo "Default cursor size"; fi

metadata.explanation: This task requires increasing the mouse pointer/cursor size. The evaluator checks if the cursor size is greater than 24 pixels (default is usually 24). The setting is org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size. This is similar in difficulty to the original task - both require navigating accessibility settings and adjusting a single setting. No custom functions needed as we use existing check_include_exclude metric.
